## Dropship for SteamOS 0.1.1

Fixes the app hanging the desktop when the machine is shut down or logged out, and adds a
version to the window. One archive, one command.

### Fixed in this release

- **Shutting down no longer raises a *Not Responding* dialog.** The app used to do its
  polling on the UI thread — a `ps` fork, a `systemctl` round trip, and `stat` calls across
  the Steam library, including removable ones. Those calls are quick during normal use and
  stop being quick while the system is tearing itself down, which is exactly when the
  compositor decides the window has stopped answering and offers to force-kill it. All of
  that work now runs on background threads, and the process exits immediately on the signal
  a session sends when it ends.
- The window now shows its version, at the top right of the heading.

### Verified on a real Steam Deck

Everything verified for 0.1.0 still holds: the nftables/cgroup-v2 blocking mechanism; the
manual Apply and Disable path in the app; the installer, the launcher entry and the uninstall
round trip; and the watcher service applying blocks on launch and removing them on exit —
that last one driven against a stand-in process shaped exactly like Steam's game scope, not
against Overwatch itself.

The shutdown path this release is about was also exercised on hardware, where the dialog
that prompted the fix did not recur.

### Not yet verified

A real Overwatch launch driving the automatic path end to end. Unchanged from 0.1.0: the
stand-in imitates the cgroup faithfully, but it is not the game. If the rules do not appear
within about ten seconds of a real launch, that is the known gap — the manual Apply path in
the app is the fallback, and it is unaffected.

### Install

```sh
tar -xzf dropship-steamos-0.1.1-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
cd dropship-steamos-0.1.1
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
sudo ./install.sh
```

That installs the privileged helper, the watcher service and a **Dropship for SteamOS**
entry in the application launcher. Open it, choose your regions, and switch on **Block while
Overwatch runs**. Remove everything again with `sudo ./install.sh --uninstall`.

If you already have 0.1.0 installed, running the same commands upgrades it in place; there is
no separate upgrade step, and your region selection is left alone.

Requires x86_64 SteamOS. Built on Ubuntu 24.04, which is older than the Deck's glibc — so
nothing newer than what the Deck already has is required. The binaries are dynamically
linked against glibc, so they are not portable to musl distributions.
